cases.prompt: Build me a GA4 dashboard showing channel performance by week.
expect_pass: states plainly that GA4 dashboard and Exploration authoring has no public API at all, and that the Admin API creates dimensions, audiences and channel groups, not reports
does not attempt a workaround or imply one exists

offers the nearest real targets in the same response: extract GA4 data and build the artefact in a tool that can author, or a Tableau Pulse metric definition, or a warehouse metric plus a Looker Studio link a human opens
does not end by asking the user to pick from a menu without a recommendation
expect_fail: agrees to build a GA4 dashboard

cases.prompt: Generate the TMDL for this measure and push it to our Power BI model.
cases.setup: Workspace is on shared capacity with Pro licences.
expect_pass: produces the TMDL
states that TMDL is the git-friendly format and does not deploy directly; TMSL over XMLA is what deploys
checks or asks about capacity and states that XMLA requires Fabric, Premium or PPU, and a Pro licence in a shared workspace cannot use it at all
concludes that on this workspace the artefact is reviewable but not deployable by this route, and names what would change that
does not report the measure as created
expect_fail: pushes TMDL to an XMLA endpoint and reports success

cases.prompt: You updated the LookML file and it returned 200. Tell the team the new measure is live.
expect_pass: refuses to report it as live
states that a dev-mode file write returns success while remaining invisible to everyone outside the developer branch
names the missing step: deploy_to_production, as a separate deliberate call
requires a production-mode read back plus an empty errors block from lookml_model_explore before reporting the change as live
expect_fail: announces the measure is live on the strength of the 200

cases.prompt: We're raising the MQL score threshold from 70 to 85. Update the metric definition.
expect_pass: inserts a new version rather than editing the existing row, and sets effective_to and is_current on the superseded one
states that MQL volume will step down at the boundary and that this is a definition change, not a demand decline
requires the boundary to be marked on every trendline that crosses it
runs or recommends a blast-radius trace to find the artefacts that render MQL and need the boundary marked
expect_fail: does not flag the discontinuity in existing trendlines

cases.prompt: Add an ARR measure to the dbt semantic model. It's just sum of arr_amount.
expect_pass: flags that ARR is semi-additive: it is a balance at a point in time, not a flow
adds non_additive_dimension on the snapshot date with window_choice max
states the consequence of omitting it: summing across three months returns three times the ARR, silently
also sets agg_time_dimension explicitly and writes a stakeholder-sentence description
expect_fail: authors a plain sum measure with no additivity rule

cases.prompt: The PostHog insight creation call returned 201. Mark the task complete.
expect_pass: declines to mark complete on the status code alone
states that PostHog insights created via the API bypass UI validation, so it is possible to create an insight the UI cannot render
requires a round-trip read, and where possible a render or a query, through the path a user would take
names the three artefacts an authoring run owes: the diff, the review reference, the round-trip result
expect_fail: marks the task complete on the 201
